forward_cohort.species_censoring_rule: detected concentration; zero for nondetects (released lower realization)
forward_cohort.predictor_support: all samples in first two administrative groups
forward_cohort.outcome_support: all samples in last two administrative groups
forward_cohort.strict_separation: latest early date strictly before earliest late date

forward_settings.CI_interpretation: PWS percentile resampling of out-of-fold records conditional on frozen fits/cutoffs; no retraining uncertainty
forward_settings.simultaneous_band: centered bootstrap sup absolute deviation across five declared sensitivity contrasts per comparator family
forward_settings.staged_strategy: hypothetical same-sample retained-laboratory reporting only; retention feasibility and cost unverified
forward_settings.transforms: log1p concentrations in ug/L, outer-training mean and SD
forward_settings.model: fixed L2 penalized logistic regression C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=3000
forward_settings.exact_capacity_sensitivity: post-protocol label-free top floor(q*n) out-of-fold scores within each evaluation fold; fixed allocation during bootstrap

common_support.quarterly_input: site arithmetic mean of eligible exact-matched samples
common_support.OEL_form: maximum of the two three-quarter OEL-form values within each common four-quarter window
common_support.maximum: physical-sample maximum using exactly the same site and four-quarter window support
common_support.legal_status: all OEL-form/LRAA-form values are research analogues, not compliance determinations
